Sofia, I posted the draft bullets for June as a reply to your message in #coastal-team. I haven't sent them to June.

- **Rename:** the bullets cover Pellow Home Living's rename from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb.
- **Two PHL accounts:** "PHL" now matches both Pellow and Pellucid Harbor Logistics. Both the #coastal-team thread and Moss's cheat sheet say this.
- **Saved report:** Moss's coverage digest is dated 18 May. It says the saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals", and I can't tell whether it has been fixed since. The draft says so.
- **Ticket and workaround:** the draft cites PD-4821 and the Mid-Atlantic vs. Gulf Coast workaround.
- **Ask for June:** relabel the report and stop using bare "PHL". I added this ask myself, so edit it if it isn't what you want.

Tell me if you want any changes, or if I should send it to June by DM or mail.
